title: architecture-tradeoff-analysis-skill Output
description: Output contract for a completed architectural trade-off analysis

chosen_option.description: The option currently in Architecture.md or recommended by this analysis.

primary_tension.description: The single core trade-off tension (e.g., 'Simplicity vs. future scalability').

evaluation_table.description: Scored comparison table. One row per alternative, one column per criterion.

gains.description: Concrete benefits of the chosen option.

sacrifices.description: Concrete costs or limitations of the chosen option.

revisit_trigger.description: Condition under which this decision should be revisited (e.g., 'If MAU exceeds 500k or cron job count exceeds 20').

recommendation.description: Whether the analysis validates the current Architecture.md decision or suggests a change.

recommended_next_action.description: If recommendation is recommends_change or escalate_to_council, what the next action is.

analysis_written_to.description: Path to the document where the trade-off section was appended.
